articles.title: A força dos termoplásticos na indústria de Manaus | G1
articles.body:
A força dos termoplásticos na indústria de Manaus — Foto: Foto: Divulgação/Suframa

Quando se fala no Polo Industrial de Manaus (PIM), motocicletas, celulares e televisores costumam ocupar o centro da conversa. Mas um segmento menos visível para o consumidor merece atenção pelo desempenho e pelas conexões com diferentes atividades econômicas: o termoplástico. Seu avanço envolve mercados, fornecedores, tecnologia e a capacidade do Amazonas de ampliar sua participação nas cadeias industriais.

Segundo o caderno de indicadores da Superintendência da Zona Franca de Manaus (Suframa), o subsetor faturou aproximadamente R$ 17,7 bilhões entre janeiro e agosto de 2026, ante R$ 13,3 bilhões no mesmo período de 2025. O crescimento nominal ficou próximo de 33%. Com participação de cerca de 10,7% no faturamento do PIM, figura entre os cinco maiores segmentos na classificação apresentada pela autarquia.

É um avanço expressivo, mas que precisa ser compreendido para orientar decisões de investimento e desenvolvimento industrial. A receita mostra a dimensão econômica alcançada; não explica, sozinha, de onde veio todo o crescimento nem se esse movimento será duradouro.

Termoplásticos são materiais que amolecem quando aquecidos e podem ser moldados em diferentes formatos. Estão presentes em embalagens, carcaças, peças técnicas e componentes. Essa diversidade de aplicações ajuda a entender sua ligação com outras indústrias: quando aumenta a produção de bens que utilizam peças plásticas, podem surgir novas encomendas para os fornecedores desses materiais e produtos.

Em Manaus, há sinais compatíveis com essa dinâmica. Entre janeiro e agosto, a produção de motocicletas, motonetas e ciclomotores avançou aproximadamente 10,8%; a de celulares, 9,2%; e a de micro-ondas, 16,8%, segundo a Suframa. Esses resultados mostram o aquecimento de parte do parque industrial, embora não permitam calcular quanto cada atividade contribuiu para a expansão dos termoplásticos.

A leitura do Centro da Indústria do Estado do Amazonas (Cieam) reforça esse ambiente de demanda. Em análise divulgada em setembro, a entidade apontou que duas rodas operava perto da capacidade máxima, diante de um mercado firme, e também destacou o desempenho de informática e eletrônicos. O crescimento dessas atividades oferece uma explicação plausível para parte das oportunidades dos fornecedores. Seria insuficiente, porém, atribuir todo o resultado dos termoplásticos às montadoras locais.

O detalhamento da Suframa recomenda ampliar o olhar. Até agosto, aproximadamente 86% do faturamento do subsetor termoplástico estava classificado como destinado ao mercado nacional, cerca de 14% ao regional e uma parcela inferior a 0,1% ao exterior. A aquisição de insumos também mostra conexões externas: aproximadamente 59% do valor das compras tinha origem estrangeira.

Essa distribuição muda a interpretação do crescimento. A expansão industrial local pode favorecer fornecedores, mas a sustentação do setor também depende de sua capacidade de disputar clientes em outras regiões. Para compreender o resultado, é necessário considerar o mercado brasileiro, a composição dos produtos vendidos e a competitividade das empresas que produzem em Manaus.

No país, o cenário combina oportunidades e pressão competitiva. Segundo o Perfil Abiplast 2026, elaborado pela Associação Brasileira da Indústria do Plástico, a produção de transformados plásticos alcançou aproximadamente 7,6 milhões de toneladas em 2025, alta de 1,3%. O consumo aparente, indicador que considera produção nacional, importações e exportações, cresceu 1,6%, enquanto as importações avançaram 20% em volume. Parte do mercado brasileiro, portanto, vem sendo atendida por mercadorias fabricadas no exterior.

Os períodos e as medidas são diferentes: a estatística brasileira retrata produção física em 2025; a de Manaus, faturamento nos oito primeiros meses de 2026. Não cabe comparar diretamente essas taxas. Ainda assim, o panorama nacional aponta que o aumento do consumo não garante, por si só, mais espaço para os fabricantes brasileiros.

Também é preciso distinguir receita de quantidade produzida. Preços, volume vendido e mudanças na composição dos produtos podem elevar o faturamento. Os dados agregados consultados não separam esses efeitos nem identificam a contribuição de cada grupo comprador. O crescimento está documentado, porém sua explicação completa exige informações mais detalhadas sobre volumes, preços e mercados atendidos.

A atividade termoplástica reúne competências que vão da transformação de resinas à engenharia de moldes, fabricação de componentes, produção de embalagens e recuperação de materiais.

Fundada em Manaus em 1978, a Masa Molds & Plastics atua na transformação de termoplásticos e no desenvolvimento de soluções para clientes de segmentos como duas rodas, eletrônicos e linha branca. Sua trajetória mostra que a presença dessa indústria no Amazonas foi construída ao longo de décadas, acompanhando necessidades de diferentes fabricantes.

A Tutiplast, com mais de 30 anos de atuação, incorporou à sua estratégia o desenvolvimento de biocompósitos com fibras amazônicas. Segundo a Federação das Indústrias do Estado do Amazonas (Fieam), a iniciativa utiliza materiais como ouriço da castanha e curauá e busca alternativas de menor pegada de carbono. O exemplo aproxima a transformação industrial de matérias-primas regionais e abre possibilidades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de produtos.

Na recuperação de materiais, a Halboor descreve uma operação que recebe plásticos de cooperativas e empresas, realiza a moagem em Manaus e encaminha parte do material para São Paulo. O caso mostra que essa cadeia também envolve preparação e circulação de matérias-primas recuperadas.

Embora não representem todo o setor, esses exemplos mostram oportunidades no desenvolvimento de moldes, na engenharia de materiais, na incorporação de fibras regionais, na automação e na recuperação de resíduos. São atividades que podem ampliar o conhecimento técnico e os negócios associados à produção.

No caso do Amazonas, atender clientes distantes exige combinar preço, qualidade e regularidade nas entregas. A proximidade com algumas montadoras pode facilitar o relacionamento industrial, enquanto as vendas para outras regiões colocam transporte, estoques e prazos no centro da competitividade.

A presença de insumos importados acrescenta exposição ao câmbio e às condições do abastecimento internacional. A logística precisa ser acompanhada especialmente quando a estiagem restringe a navegação e pode pressionar custos e prazos. Mesmo com vendas concentradas no mercado brasileiro, parte das condições de produção depende de acontecimentos fora do país.

Há espaço para competir pela capacidade técnica: desenvolver peças, aperfeiçoar moldes, reduzir desperdícios e atender a especificações mais exigentes. Esse caminho demanda profissionais qualificados, engenharia, automação e aproximação entre empresas, universidades e instituições de ciência e tecnologia. Programas de apoio à inovação podem contribuir, conforme as regras e a elegibilidade de cada projeto.

A circularidade também integra essa agenda. A Abiplast informa que o Brasil produziu cerca de 1,1 milhão de toneladas de resinas recicladas pós-consumo em 2025, diante de capacidade instalada de aproximadamente 2,4 milhões de toneladas. A diferença indica espaço para expansão, mas a entidade aponta entraves relacionados à coleta, triagem, qualidade, rastreabilidade e competitividade dos materiais recuperados.

Além disso, a viabilidade desses negócios no Amazonas, também precisa considerar a distância entre os pontos de geração, processamento e consumo dos materiais, além da regularidade do transporte. Aproximar recuperação de resíduos e desenvolvimento de produtos pode gerar negócios, desde que haja fornecimento consistente e atendimento aos requisitos técnicos de cada aplicação.

O avanço dos termoplásticos merece ser acompanhado pelo que pode deixar na economia amazonense. Além da receita, interessam a capacidade de conquistar mercados, formar profissionais, desenvolver soluções industriais e sustentar empregos.

No acumulado até agosto de 2026, o subsetor registrou média mensal de aproximadamente 15,8 mil trabalhadores, incluindo efetivos, temporários e terceirizados, segundo a Suframa. O número dimensiona sua importância para o trabalho industrial no estado.

O aumento do faturamento, entretanto, não permite concluir quanto houve de ganho de produtividade, ampliação da produção ou mudança nos preços. Para o Amazonas, importa acompanhar como esse desempenho se traduz em qualificação, desenvolvimento de fornecedores e oportunidades de trabalho.

Uma cadeia produtiva mais forte se constrói quando as empresas transformam um período favorável de vendas em ganhos duradouros de produtividade, tecnologia e empregos qualificados. O avanço dos termoplásticos precisa ampliar também o conhecimento técnico, os fornecedores e o valor econômico que permanecem no Amazonas.

Cristina Monte é jornalista, colunista e analista de negócios, com atuação na cobertura de indústria, inovação e desenvolvimento econômico na Amazônia.

articles.title: Polilaminina: Anvisa registra 9 mortes e impõe restrições  | G1
articles.standfirst: Substância ainda em testes é aplicada em pacientes por uso compassivo. Pesquisadora diz que acesso foi dificultado. Agência defende que mudança ocorreu após morte de nove pacientes fora do protocolo que hoje é exigido.
articles.summary: Substância ainda em testes é aplicada em pacientes por uso compassivo. Pesquisadora diz que acesso foi dificultado. Agência defende que mudança ocorreu após morte de nove pacientes
articles.body:
A Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária ( Anvisa ) impôs novas regras para o uso compassivo da polilaminina após o registro de nove mortes entre pacientes que receberam a substância . Em um vídeo divulgado nas redes sociais, a pesquisadora Tatiana Sampaio, responsável pelos estudos, acusou a agência de impor restrições ao acesso.

“[Agora] tudo depende de uma correria louca, que poucas pessoas conseguem cumprir", disse Tatiana em vídeo.

Até agora, a polilaminina foi aplicada em 119 pacientes. Nove morreram posteriormente. Segundo o laboratório responsável pela substância, não há relação entre as mortes e as aplicações. Todos os nove pacientes que morreram estavam fora do protocolo da pesquisa clínica.

As aplicações ocorreram por meio do chamado uso compassivo , modalidade que permite a pacientes em estado grave e sem alternativas de tratamento receber substâncias ainda em fase de testes, mediante autorização da Anvisa.

Ao g1, a agência informou com exclusividade que decidiu impor novas restrições ao uso compassivo após ser comunicada, em março, sobre as cinco primeiras mortes. Os pacientes também não atendiam aos critérios do protocolo que passou a ser exigido.

O Cristália, laboratório responsável pelo desenvolvimento da polilaminina, afirmou que respeita a decisão da Anvisa e repudiou os ataques às decisões e aos servidores da agência. (Leia mais abaixo.)

➡️ O que é a polilaminina? É uma substância derivada da laminina, proteína presente naturalmente nos tecidos do corpo e que ajuda a dar suporte às células. Ela está sendo estudada para uso em pessoas com lesões na medula espinhal, incluindo pacientes que ficaram paraplégicos ou tetraplégicos. A hipótese dos pesquisadores é que, ao ser aplicada na região lesionada, a substância possa estimular a regeneração de conexões nervosas e favorecer a recuperação de movimentos. Sua eficácia e segurança, no entanto, ainda estão sendo investigadas.

Hoje, a substância avança por dois caminhos:

Um estudo clínico , que deve responder se ela funciona e que foi aprovado pela Anvisa em janeiro. Porém, ele ainda não começou. De acordo com o laboratório, ainda não foi possível recrutar pacientes.

Enquanto isso, o laboratório Cristália fornece a substância por uso compassivo . Cirurgia, equipe e internação ficam a cargo do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) ou da rede privada.

Previsto em norma da Anvisa desde 2013, o uso compassivo permite que pacientes graves e sem alternativa recebam medicamentos ainda em teste , com autorização caso a caso.

Tatiana defende que a polilaminina seja liberada para pessoas com lesão completa em qualquer altura da medula, inclusive no pescoço, o que inclui os tetraplégicos.

Segundo ela, até abril, pacientes com lesão de até três meses conseguiam a autorização para o uso compassivo na agência. Agora, a Anvisa passou a autorizar apenas pacientes com lesões de até 72 horas , localizadas entre as vértebras T2 e T10, na altura do tórax.

“Em abril desse ano, a diretoria da Anvisa chamou a empresa fabricante da polilaminina para uma reunião de alinhamento. Nessa reunião, a diretora Daniela Marreco informou que não ia mais autorizar os pedidos que estavam chegando e obrigou a empresa a impor restrições ao uso compassivo", disse Tatiana em vídeo.

Entre janeiro e março de 2026, a empresa comunicou à Anvisa a morte de cinco pacientes que haviam recebido a polilaminina, mas não atendiam aos critérios estabelecidos no protocolo da pesquisa clínica. Desde então, o número de mortes chegou a nove. Todos os pacientes que morreram estavam fora dos critérios clínicos atualmente exigidos pela agência.

Diante desses registros, a Anvisa reavaliou os riscos e os possíveis benefícios da substância e decidiu restringir o uso compassivo aos pacientes que atendam aos mesmos critérios de inclusão da pesquisa clínica. Segundo a agência, a medida será mantida até que haja mais evidências sobre a segurança da polilaminina.

A Anvisa informou ainda que consultou um painel técnico formado por representantes do Conselho Federal de Medicina (CFM), neurologistas e neurocirurgiões brasileiros e estrangeiros para avaliar a possibilidade de ampliar o uso compassivo da substância.

Segundo a agência, os especialistas recomendaram, por unanimidade, que o uso não fosse ampliado , diante das preocupações com as mortes registradas e com a forma de aplicação.

➡️ A aplicação da polilaminina é um procedimento complexo, feito diretamente na região lesionada da medula espinhal. Em fevereiro, Tatiana afirmou ao g1 que seria necessário treinar médicos para realizar as aplicações em diferentes regiões do país.

E o que muda agora? Com as novas regras, o uso compassivo da substância fica restrito a pacientes que atendam aos critérios do protocolo da pesquisa clínica, incluindo lesões ocorridas há, no máximo, três dias e localizadas em uma região específica da coluna torácica. É essa limitação que Tatiana contesta.

Além de defender a ampliação do acesso à substância, a pesquisadora argumenta que os dados obtidos com o uso compassivo poderiam ajudar a modificar o desenho do estudo clínico que ainda será realizado.

“Se no final os dados de uso compassivo justificarem uma alteração do desenho experimental da pesquisa científica, isso não é necessariamente corrupto”, afirmou.

Antes do início dos testes com a polilaminina, pacientes estão acionando a Justiça em busca do tratamento — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

Tatiana também defende estender o acesso a pessoas com lesões antigas, que convivem com a paralisia há anos. Um dos casos citados é o de Tiba Camargos, que ficou tetraplégico depois de um acidente em que tentava salvar o filho de um afogamento no interior do Rio Grande do Sul. A lesão aconteceu em fevereiro de 2025 e ele quer testar a substância.

Tatiana defende que isso seja possível. No vídeo, ela afirma que a proposta se apoia em um estudo com cães, concluído no ano passado, que segundo ela indicou ser possível alguma melhora mesmo anos após a lesão.

Em nota, o Cristália informou que os estudos em cães ainda não foram finalizados e que, sem isso, não há como seguir para etapas com pacientes.

No vídeo, Tatiana também cita que seria possível usar os dados de uso compassivo para alterar o desenho experimental da pesquisa científica . Desde a divulgação da pesquisa da polilaminina, ela vem recebendo críticas por ter dito ser contra um grupo controle no estudo.

Em estudos clínicos, o mais comum é que os pacientes sejam divididos em dois grupos: um que recebe o tratamento e outro que não recebe. A comparação entre os dois ajuda a entender se a melhora observada é realmente causada pela substância.

Ela não explica no vídeo como faria o uso dos dados. Porém, as regras da Anvisa, que é quem regulamenta os estudos científicos feitos para medicamentos, não permitem que esses dados sejam usados para construir evidências. A única permissão é de que sejam usados como informação suplementar a um possível pedido de aprovação, depois da pesquisa pronta.

Em nota, o Cristália disse que nenhum dado gerado pelo uso compassivo pode ser utilizado para fins regulatórios e que, por isso, não está nos planos do laboratório alterar em nada o desenho do estudo em andamento.

Segundo a Anvisa, esses quadros estão entre os óbitos.

O que se sabe sobre quem já usou a substância?

Os dados de uso compassivo são coletados pelo Cristália e repassados à Anvisa. Em uma apresentação na Rio Innovation Week, em agosto, Tatiana apresentou dados de 17 pacientes, dos mais de 100 que receberam a substância.

Dez deles mostraram alguma mudança na escala AIS, usada para classificar a gravidade das lesões na medula.

Esses pacientes passaram da categoria A, de lesão completa, para B ou C. A mudança indica que recuperaram alguma sensibilidade ou movimento na região anal, um avanço bem distante de voltar a andar.

Entre as 110 aplicações, foram registradas nove mortes. O laboratório informou, no entanto, que elas não são relacionadas ao uso do medicamento.

No vídeo, Tatiana faz acusações de interferência da Anvisa e aponta uma das diretoras, Daniela Marreco, a quem se refere como “uma pessoa fria, uma pessoa sem emoções” . Ela alega que as decisões da diretora, como integrante da diretoria colegiada, são “maldade”.

Em nota, a Anvisa repudiou os ataques e disse que as decisões da agência e de seus servidores são técnicas.

“A Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária vem a público repudiar qualquer forma de ataque pessoal a seus servidores e membros da diretoria colegiada por decisões tomadas no exercício de suas funções, em cumprimento à legislação nacional e à proteção da saúde. O uso de expressões como ‘maldade’ ou ‘mente pervertida’ é absolutamente inaceitável, especialmente vindo de pesquisadores ou representantes do setor farmacêutico, e desloca a argumentação para um território que não tem como base a regulação e a ciência.

Desde sua fundação, a Anvisa atua com base em critérios técnicos e tendo como foco a saúde da população brasileira - e seu histórico de serviços prestados à sociedade comprova a qualidade e o cuidado desse trabalho. A Agência também preza pelo respeito a qualquer cidadão, inadmitindo, portanto, posturas desrespeitosas perante seu corpo técnico e sua diretoria”, disse em nota.

O Cristália, que está à frente da pesquisa da polilaminina, disse em nota que desconhece perseguição na agência e manifestou apoio à diretora e à Anvisa.

“Dadas as recentes manifestações a respeito da Polilaminina, o Laboratório Cristália reafirma sua plena confiança na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (ANVISA) e manifesta seu apoio integral à Dra. Daniela Marreco e a todos os profissionais que dedicam suas carreiras à avaliação técnica, ética e independente de medicamentos, produtos biológicos e novas terapias voltadas à população brasileira.

Ao longo das últimas décadas, a ANVISA consolidou-se como uma das mais respeitadas agências regulatórias do mundo, sendo responsável por assegurar que medicamentos, vacinas, dispositivos médicos e novas tecnologias em saúde atendam aos mais elevados padrões de qualidade, segurança e eficácia antes de serem disponibilizados à sociedade”, disse em nota.

O laboratório ainda reforçou que “o uso compassivo, os acessos expandidos e outras modalidades especiais de tratamento representam instrumentos extremamente importantes e humanitários. Entretanto, essas alternativas não substituem a necessidade de geração de evidências clínicas robustas”.

articles.title: Incêndio em fábrica de pães no Distrito Industrial, em João Pessoa | G1
articles.standfirst: De acordo com o Corpo de Bombeiros, equipes foram acionadas para o controle das chamas no local. A causa do incêndio ainda não foi confirmada.
articles.summary: O incêndio em fábrica de pães em João Pessoa mobiliza diversas equipes do Corpo de Bombeiros no Distrito Industrial para conter as chamas nesta quinta-feira.
articles.body:
Um incêndio de grandes proporções foi registrado em uma fábrica de panificação no Distrito Industrial, em João Pessoa , na tarde desta quinta-feira (22). A informação foi confirmada pelo Corpo de Bombeiros.

De acordo com informações apuradas pela TV Cabo Branco , o fogo teria iniciado na fábrica de panificação por volta das 15h e provavelmente teria começado na parte da linha de produção de pães congelados.

Uma equipe terceirizada foi solicitada para fazer uma manutenção na estrutura da fábrica e o princípio de incêndio teria ligação com um serviço de solda que estava sendo feito nas máquinas. Essa possibilidade ainda será investigada pelos órgãos.

O fogo se espalhou rapidamente e atingiu, ainda, parte de uma distribuidora.

De acordo com os Bombeiros ao g1 , várias guarnições foram encaminhadas para o controle das chamas. Até a última atualização desta reportagem, não havia informações sobre possíveis feridos ou a causa do incêndio.

Uma perícia do Corpo de Bombeiros deve apurar o que motivou o incêndio.

articles.title: Feminicídio em Nova Iguaçu: preso alegou que vítima se feriu sozinha | G1
articles.standfirst: Maxwel de Souza Gomes foi preso em flagrante pelo feminicídio de Valéria de Jesus Lima. Em depoimento, ele afirmou que a vítima, agredida com três facadas, teria se machucado sozinha.
articles.summary: Preso pelo feminicídio de Valéria de Jesus Lima em Nova Iguaçu, Maxwel de Souza Gomes alegou que a vítima se feriu, mas perícia técnica desmentiu a versão.
articles.body:
Valéria Silva de Jesus Lima foi assassinada em Nova Iguaçu — Foto: Reprodução

Preso em flagrante nesta quinta-feira (22) em flagrante por feminicídio contra sua mulher , Maxwel de Souza Gomes, de 37 anos, afirmou em depoimento que a vítima, Valéria Silva de Jesus Lima, teria se machucado sozinha.

Segundo o delegado da Delegacia de Homicídios da Baixada Fluminense (DHBF), Nathan Aceti, a polícia já descartou esta versão

A investigação apontou que as duas lesões no tórax da vítima e uma terceira, embaixo da axila direita, não poderiam ter sido causadas por ela, que era destra. Segundo a polícia, o próprio suspeito confirmou esse detalhe.

Diversas testemunhas foram ouvidas, incluindo o padrasto de Maxwel, dono do imóvel onde Valéria foi esfaqueada. Após os depoimentos, a polícia concluiu que o marido foi o autor do crime

Valéria de Jesus Lima foi agredida a facadasna manhã desta quinta-feira (22). Ela foi socorrida e levada para a Unidade de Pronto Atendimento (UPA) da região, mas não resistiu aos ferimentos.

O Corpo de Bombeiros foi acionado às 11h20 para o recolhimento do corpo. Valéria deixou seis filhos. Os três mais novos moram com o pai, ex-marido dela.

De acordo com o delegado Nathan Aceti, Maxwel foi detido na UPA para onde Valéria foi socorrida. Agentes seguiram para a Comunidade Três Campos, onde o crime ocorreu, para perícia.

No local do crime, policiais encontraram o cabo de uma faca sem a lâmina.

articles.standfirst: Motoristas terão de fazer cadastro gratuito no DMTT e instalar adesivos nos veículos. Órgão ainda não informou quando começará a regularização.
articles.summary: Motoristas terão de fazer cadastro gratuito no DMTT e instalar adesivos nos veículos. Órgão ainda não informou quando começará a regularização.
articles.body:
Uma nova lei autorizou motoristas de aplicativo a utilizarem as faixas exclusivas de ônibus, conhecidas como Faixas Azuis, em Maceió .

A medida foi publicada no Diário Oficial do Município nesta quinta-feira (22). Apesar disso, os profissionais ainda precisarão fazer cadastro gratuito no Departamento Municipal de Transportes e Trânsito (DMTT) e identificar os veículos antes de usar os corredores.

A autorização vale para corredores como os das avenidas Fernandes Lima e Durval de Góes Monteiro, hoje destinados prioritariamente a ônibus e táxis.

Faixa azul ônibus maceió avenida durval de góes monteiro — Foto: Secom Maceió

Para utilizar as faixas, os motoristas deverão apresentar documentos que comprovem a propriedade do veículo. No caso de carros alugados, será necessário apresentar o contrato de locação.

Os automóveis também precisarão ser cadastrados no DMTT e receber adesivos de identificação autorizados pelo órgão.

Faixa Azul - Pintura — Foto: Pei Fon Secom /Maceió

Para ter acesso às Faixas Azuis, os profissionais deverão cumprir as seguintes exigências:

comprovar a propriedade do carro ou apresentar contrato de aluguel;

instalar adesivos de identificação autorizados pelo órgão;

A medida teve origem no Projeto de Lei nº 41/2025, aprovado pela Câmara Municipal de Maceió em 26 de novembro de 2025.

O DMTT ainda não informou quando os motoristas poderão realizar o cadastro, como será feita a identificação dos veículos ou quanto tempo levará o processo de regularização.

articles.title: Exames gratuitos em Piracicaba: mamografia e papanicolau | G1
articles.standfirst: Atendimentos ocorrem nesta sexta (23) e sábado (24) com foco em mulheres sem plano médico na sede da Associação Viva a Vida. Unidades de Saúde também fazem mutirões; saiba como agendar.
articles.summary: Exames gratuitos em Piracicaba ocorrem nesta sexta e sábado na Associação Viva a Vida e em unidades de saúde para mulheres sem plano médico.
articles.body:
Piracicaba tem mutirões de exames preventivos contra o câncer de mama — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

Piracicaba (SP) oferece diferentes mutirões de prevenção e conscientização sobre o câncer de mama entre esta sexta-feira (23) e no sábado (24), com atendimentos na sede da Associação Viva a Vida para agendamentos de mamografias e ultrassons a mulheres que não têm convênio médico, a partir das 8h.

Unidades da rede municipal de saúde da cidade também exames de. A iniciativa ocorre durante campanha de prevenção da doença, tradicionalmente todo mês de outubro.

A Associação Viva a Vida realiza a 2ª edição da campanha de prevenção ao câncer de mama nesta sexta-feira (23) e no sábado (24), em Piracicaba (SP). A iniciativa ofedere mamografias e ultrassons para mulheres com encaminhamento médico, que fizeram exame há mais de um ano e que não possuem plano de saúde.

O atendimento será por ordem de chegada, na sede da instituição, das 8h às 12h e das 13h às 17h. A Associação Viva a Vida fica na Rua José Pinto de Almeida, nº 824, no Centro de Piracicaba.

A iniciativa é uma parceria com o CPA e reúne médicos voluntários nos dois dias.

Associação Vida a Vida oferece agendamentos de exames de mamografias e ultrassom — Foto: Associação Viva Vida Mulheres Mastectomizadas /Reprodução

"Voluntárias da associação vão acolher as participantes, auxiliar na triagem e distribuir materiais informativos sobre o câncer de mama. A campanha também aborda a importância dos exames de rotina e do autoconhecimento corporal, importantes para o diagnóstico precoce", detalhou a organização.

De acordo com a Viva a Vida, as mamografias são custeadas pela associação, com apoio de empresas, indústrias, igrejas e colaboradores da comunidade.

Ao longo do ano, a entidade realiza ações de apoio às mulheres em tratamento, ao oferecer perucas, lenços, próteses mamárias, sutiãs adaptados, medicamentos complementares, cestas básicas para famílias em vulnerabilidade, atendimentos psicológicos e encontros de convivência.

No sábado (24), 66 unidades de saúde de Piracicaba (SP) realizarão mutirões de atendimento à mulher, com consultas e exames agendados e também por livre demanda, das 8h às 14h. Serão oferecidos serviços como coleta do exame de papanicolau, vacinação, testes rápidos, avaliação de saúde bucal e consulta médica.

A ação compõe a programação do Outubro Rosa, campanha para conscientização sobre a importância da prevenção e do diagnóstico precoce do câncer de mama e promoção da saúde feminina.

De acordo com a Secretaria de Saúde de Piracicaba, não estarão abertas no sábado as unidades USF Artemis 1, USF Artemis 2, USF Boa Esperança 2, USF Parque Orlanda, USF Primavera, UBS Cecap, UBS Tanquinho e UBS Novo Horizonte. As demais unidades de saúde do município vão funcionar das 8h às 14h, com atendimentos agendados e por livre demanda.

articles.title: Governo federal vai reforçar combate a incêndios no Oeste do Pará; Santarém terá seis aviões de apoio  | G1
articles.standfirst: Operação prevê 287 brigadistas, 33 veículos terrestres e 12 aeronaves para combater o fogo. Ibama identificou 62 incêndios florestais ativos em um raio de 150 km da área urbana de Santarém.
articles.summary: Operação prevê 287 brigadistas, 33 veículos terrestres e 12 aeronaves para combater o fogo. Ibama identificou 62 incêndios florestais ativos em um raio de 150 km da área urbana de Santarém.
articles.body:
O governo federal anunciou o reforço das ações de combate aos incêndios florestais no Oeste do Pará. Entre as medidas previstas estão o envio de equipes para atuar em campo, o uso de aeronaves no combate às chamas e o reforço da segurança dos brigadistas em áreas de conflito.

A operação prevê 287 brigadistas do Instituto Brasileiro do Meio Ambiente e dos Recursos Naturais Renováveis (Ibama) e do Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservação da Biodiversidade (ICMBio), além de 33 veículos terrestres e 12 aeronaves.

Do total de aeronaves mobilizadas, seis são aviões do modelo Air Tractor, utilizados para lançar água sobre as chamas, que ficarão baseados na região de Santarém .

Na área de influência do município, o Ibama identificou 62 incêndios florestais ativos em um raio de 150 quilômetros da zona urbana. A região do Chapadão, na divisa entre Santarém e Uruará, está entre as áreas que preocupam as autoridades devido à pressão sobre a floresta e aos relatos de uso intencional do fogo.

O reforço foi anunciado durante uma coletiva com representantes dos ministérios do Meio Ambiente, do Desenvolvimento Agrário e da Justiça, além de órgãos federais responsáveis pela fiscalização ambiental e pela proteção de territórios indígenas.

Entre as medidas estão o emprego de brigadistas no combate direto ao fogo, o apoio de veículos terrestres e aeronaves e o envio da Força Nacional para reforçar a segurança das equipes que atuam em áreas onde foram relatados episódios de hostilidade.

Segundo o governo federal, a Força Nacional foi autorizada a atuar após relatos de resistência contra brigadistas nas Terras Indígenas Apyterewa e Ituna/Itatá. A Polícia Federal e a Agência Brasileira de Inteligência (Abin) também investigam os responsáveis pelos incêndios criminosos.

Segundo o presidente do Ibama, Jair Schmitt, a maioria dos incêndios na Amazônia neste período está relacionada à ação humana. De acordo com ele, o fogo tem sido utilizado para limpar áreas recém-desmatadas e favorecer a ocupação ilegal de terras.

A prática preocupa especialmente na região do Chapadão, entre Santarém e Uruará, onde há pressão de invasores sobre assentamentos da reforma agrária e florestas públicas.

O governo também informou que 208 assentamentos da reforma agrária no Pará foram atingidos por incêndios, sendo sete em situação considerada extremamente crítica. As chamas avançam ainda sobre áreas protegidas, como a Floresta Nacional do Jamanxim, a Área de Proteção Ambiental Triunfo do Xingu e terras indígenas.

O Pará recebeu R$ 45 milhões do Fundo Amazônia para fortalecer a estrutura de prevenção e combate aos incêndios. Com os recursos, foram adquiridos 46 veículos especializados, sendo oito caminhões de combate e 38 caminhonetes adaptadas, além de cinco drones de monitoramento. O investimento também possibilitou a capacitação de 303 brigadistas municipais.

Santarém passou a integrar neste ano a lista de municípios prioritários do programa União com Municípios, que prevê repasses para ações de combate ao desmatamento e à degradação florestal.

A inclusão ocorreu após o aumento da degradação provocada por queimadas registrado em 2024, mesmo com a redução dos índices de desmatamento por corte raso nos anos anteriores.

Durante a coletiva, representantes do governo relacionaram o agravamento dos incêndios à seca severa e às condições climáticas associadas ao fenômeno El Niño. Segundo as autoridades, a vegetação mais seca favorece a propagação das chamas.

A previsão meteorológica apresentada pelo governo indica que o período de estiagem severa pode se estender até meados de 2027.

articles.title: Palantir's top exec Louis Mosley to Europe: You really cannot do without China, don't forget to manufacture drones you need …
articles.summary: Palantir has a message for Europe on technology dependence.
articles.body: Palantir has a message for Europe on technology dependence. Louis Mosley, the head of Palantir Technologies' UK and Europe operations, has argued that European countries will have to accept some reliance on US technology, at least in the short term, even as governments explore alternatives to American software providers. He also pointed to Europe's dependence on China for industrial components, particularly magnets required to manufacture drones.​Speaking to Bloomberg News in Brussels, Mosley argued that Europe's dependence on China for industrial supplies also deserves greater attention, particularly as countries seek to strengthen their defence capabilities and expand drone production. “You can’t manufacture drones without magnets. Magnets come from China,” he said. “You have chokepoints in the hardware realm that don’t get discussed nearly as much as the choke points in the software realm.”​Mosley added that European countries would have to recognise the limits of their efforts to become technologically self-sufficient. He said, “Europe is going to have to accept some dependency on the US, at least for the short term.”​His comments come at a time when European governments are seeking more technological independence from strained relations across the Atlantic and growing fears about access to sensitive data. A handful of countries have reviewed their contracts with Palantir, but practical needs, especially in defence, make it hard for Europe to do away with foreign technology providers entirely, Mosley said.​Why Palantir matters to European defence​Palantir provides customised data analysis software to governments and organisations, including civilian agencies, intelligence services, police forces and militaries. The company, valued at more than $480 billion, has expanded its role in defence technology through products that use artificial intelligence to analyse information and support military operations.​In 2025, NATO's military branch agreed with Palantir to deploy its Maven Smart System, which uses AI for surveillance and targeting.​Mosley described the system as “a massive enabler of lots of European defence and European technology, which, without being connected to Maven, is less valuable to Europe,” arguing that further cooperation on data sharing and integration could benefit NATO members.​The system illustrates the role that American technology companies play in European defence infrastructure, even as governments discuss reducing their reliance on foreign suppliers.​European countries reconsidering ties with Palantir​Palantir's position in Europe has faced challenges since Donald Trump's return to the US presidency last year strained transatlantic relations and increased scrutiny of American technology companies.​Chief Executive Officer Alex Karp has cultivated close ties with the Trump administration and promoted a strong pro-American position. This has contributed to concerns among some European leaders about relying on US companies for sensitive government operations.​In June, France announced that its domestic intelligence agency would end its Palantir contract in favour of a local provider. British lawmakers have also criticised the company's work with the UK's health system.​These developments have created opportunities for European technology companies seeking to replace American providers. Mosley, however, said competition should be judged on practical performance rather than political preference.​“The more competition there is, the sharper the evaluation of what works and what doesn’t,” he said. “What we need is competition that happens in reality between two products that are using real data on a real problem.”​EU technology sovereignty plans face practical challenges​The European Union is also working on regulations intended to reduce its reliance on foreign technology providers. The European Commission is advancing a technology sovereignty package that includes the proposed Cloud and AI Development Act.​The legislation is being negotiated and could restrict access to sensitive government data to cloud and software providers under full EU control. The broader objective is to make it technically impossible for foreign powers, including the US, to access certain sensitive information.​Mosley acknowledged that some larger Western European countries had become less receptive to Palantir's products, but said the company's engagement remained strong in other markets, including Ukraine.​“The further East you go, the more engaged the customers are and the more serious they are about standing up their Palantir capabilities,” he said.​Referring to Ukraine's experience over the past four years, Mosley added: “If you were to talk to the Ukrainians, all the experience I’ve had there for the last four or five years is you need stuff that works, and you need it because if you don’t, you’re dead. And the questions around sovereignty are secondary.”​You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: South East England prepares for impact of Storm Austen
articles.summary: A yellow weather warning for high winds is issued across the region.
articles.body:
Seafront closures, cancelled events and travel disruption are expected as the first named storm of the season approaches south-east England.

The Met Office has issued a yellow weather warning for wind across the region, with gusts of up to 70mph (113km/h) forecast on Friday.

In East Sussex, sections of Eastbourne seafront promenade will close because of concerns about large waves and strong winds.

In Kent, Betteshanger Country Park near Deal said it would close on Friday because of the forecast weather conditions.

The warning covers coastal areas from 00:00 BST until 17:00 and inland areas from 10:00 until 21:00.

Storm Austen is the first named storm of the season and comes as an amber wind warning remains in force in parts of south-west England.

Forecasters have also warned of large waves and high tides along parts of the coastline.

Eastbourne Borough Council said the Bandstand would also close and some surrounding hoardings would be removed ahead of Storm Austen.

In West Sussex, Horsham's Fireworks Night on Saturday has been cancelled because of the forecast conditions.

Organisers said ticket holders would receive automatic refunds.

Ashurst Wood Bonfire Society has also cancelled its bonfire and fireworks event because of "safety concerns", with organisers hoping to reschedule it at a later date.

Organisers said they hoped to reschedule the event at a later date.

Littlehampton Bonfire Night is still due to go ahead, although organisers said a final decision would be made on Saturday.

Rail passengers have been advised to check before travelling and allow more time for their journeys.

Network Rail warned strong winds could bring trees and other objects on to tracks, leading to delays and disruption.

Gatwick Airport warned of a small number of cancellations between the West Sussex airport and the Channel Islands, while several sailings between Newhaven and Dieppe, in France, have also been cancelled on Friday.

Residents living near railway lines have been asked to secure loose items, including trampolines and garden furniture.

The Met Office said some areas could experience short-term power cuts and disruption to other services.

The RNLI said people should be aware of dangers in the sea that weather conditions might bring.

articles.title: Airbnb hosts can no longer ask guests to clean dishes or make beds
articles.summary: Airbnb hosts can only set “reasonable” housecleaning duties for guests, according to new guidelines rolled out by the tech giant, with tasks such as dishwashing and bed stripping now the sole responsibility of homeowners.
articles.body: Airbnb hosts can only set “reasonable” housecleaning duties for guests, according to new guidelines rolled out by the tech giant, with tasks such as dishwashing and bed stripping now the sole responsibility of homeowners. While Airbnb bookings have always included a cleaning fee, there hadn’t been universal policies on what hosts can ask their renters to complete. But now, starting with rentals on Nov. 20, Airbnb will limit these guest responsibilities in order to “set clear expectations” for hosts whose house rules must be “reasonable and comply with” these new requirements. Hosts cannot ask “guests to complete tasks that require significant effort or time, or would typically be performed by a cleaner, including stripping the bed, taking trash offsite, or washing and putting away dishes,” Airbnb said. The new guidelines come after years of customer complaints, travel industry expert Clint Henderson told NBC News. “So this is pretty major for consumers,” said Henderson, managing editor and spokesperson for travel industry website The Points Guy. “The complaints have been really ramping up lately with owners asking guests to do the most ridiculous things, like stripping beds, washing dishes, doing all the laundry and taking the trash out,” Henderson said. “It’s just gotten really out of hand,” he said. “And from a consumer’s perspective, it’s like, ‘Why am I going to stay at Airbnb when I have to do chores?’” While Airbnb host Gabriel Valk, in Greenville, South Carolina, believes small tasks like dishwashing and bed stripping should be “common courtesy” performed by guests, he understands why Airbnb would institute these more clear guidelines. “But I do understand the pushback,” Valk said, citing the service fees that are supposed to cover cleaning costs. “OK, you guys are paying, whatever, $100 for the cleaning. ‘We shouldn’t have to do anything,’” he imagined the guests saying. “So totally makes sense to me.” Airbnb had to give guests a break or risk consumers flocking back to traditional hotels, according to Henderson. “Why (stay at an Airbnb) when I can stay at a hotel and not have to do all that busy work?” he said. “And these days, Airbnb is as expensive, with all the fees and everything, as a hotel is. So I think Airbnb has lost some of its competitive edge over the years.”

articles.title: 'Looksmaxxing' influencer Clavicular pleads not guilty to rape charge
articles.summary: The influencer, whose real name is Braden Peters, is accused of sexually assaulting a 17-year-old girl in 2025.
articles.body:
Clavicular, a social media influencer who promotes the "looksmaxxing" trend of young men maximising their attractiveness, has pleaded not guilty to criminal charges including rape.

The 20-year-old, whose real name is Braden Peters, was charged in September with felony rape, drugging an individual for sexual intercourse and procuring alcohol for someone under the age of 21.

The charges stem from an incident in 2025 when he is accused of assaulting a 17-year-old girl at his family's Massachusetts home.

Peters has denied the allegations and said the encounter was consensual. On Thursday, he was granted $10,000 bail, ordered not to contact or post about his accuser, and to surrender his passport.

A woman told police that on 23 May 2025, Peters ordered her an Uber to his family's house in Chatham where they were drinking alcohol while filming a livestream before he allegedly raped her, according to the BBC's US partner, CBS News.

The police officer who took the report said he believed she was unable to consent due to her age and the level of intoxication she exhibited in the livestream, CBS reported.

Clavicular has more than a million followers on TikTok and Instagram and has garnered media attention for extreme measures he has taken for "looksmaxxing".

He has admitted to using a hammer on his face and jawline and taking a number of steroids, injections, and other drugs to achieve bodily perfection. He also gives advice on appearing masculine and performs stunts to shock followers.

In Florida earlier this year, he was charged after filming himself shooting at what appeared to be a dead alligator. He pleaded no contest to unlawfully discharging a firearm in public.

In March, he was arrested on suspicion of battery after authorities suspected him of instigating a fight between two women. Authorities said in July that they did not intend to file charges.

After Thursday's hearing, Peters posted a photo of himself in the black suit and black tie he wore to court, while holding his dog which he also brought to court.

His next hearing will be on 24 November, when the judge will decide if there is enough evidence for the case to move forward.

articles.title: Foreign national beaten to death by a mob in South Africa
articles.summary: Police say a 50-person mob in Durban killed a man amid a wave of anti-migrant marches.
articles.body:
A mob has beaten a foreign national to death during a protest in the South African port city of Durban, amid a wave of anti-immigrant tension.

Police said the group approached the man as he stood by the side of a road in Durban’s central business district.

The victim was allegedly assaulted by a group of about 50 people and was declared dead at the scene, a police statement said.

Police did not reveal the nationality of the man or details of the march.

They said the victim was in his 30s or early 40s, and they were still trying to identify suspects in the attack.

Durban has been at the epicentre of months of protests against foreign nationals , with looting and violence erupting after an anti-migrant march in the city two weeks ago.

Demonstrations calling for government action against African migrants who entered the country illegally began in June, with some escalating into violence.

Nigeria, Mozambique, Malawi and other countries have said some of their citizens have been killed in xenophobic attacks in South Africa.

South African authorities disputed some of those claims, saying that some deaths were linked to criminal activity.

Tens of thousands of migrants have left South Africa in recent months in one of the largest mass exoduses in years to avoid the violence.

The government also said that many were deported for not having the required papers to be in the country.

South Africa is Africa’s largest economy and migrants have moved to the country for opportunities. But communities in South Africa say there are not enough jobs and public services are overburdened.

South African President Cyril Ramaphosa has denounced anti-migrant violence but acknowledged that weak border control systems allowed undocumented migrants to travel to and stay in the country.

Government figures show there are about 2.4 million foreign nationals living among South Africa’s population of 62 million.

articles.title: Jean Linard spent 27 years building a handmade cathedral in a French quarry, covering its walls and towers with mosaics, sculpture and bright colors
articles.summary: Discover the extraordinary story of Jean Linard, who devoted 27 years to building a breathtaking handmade cathedral in a French quarry, adorned with vibrant mosaics and sculptures. Explore the legacy of this unique monument and its future.
articles.body: Certain cathedrals required a large number of masons and centuries to complete. In the hollow of an abandoned flint quarry in the Berry region of central France, Jean Linard constructed his, almost by himself. He started his outdoor cathedral in Neuvy-Deux-Clochers in the early 1980s and continued to add to it until he died in 2010. Depending on whether you count from 1983 or 1984, the project lasted about 27 years. He was a printmaker and potter. The complex is now preserved as a historic monument, with multicoloured mosaic covering its brick arches, towers, and statues.It was included in the 2012 safeguards of the French Ministry of Culture, with an order of inscription dated 16 July 2012. The protected parts are the house, its courtyard, outbuildings and gardens, the open-air cathedral and everything fastened in it. Linard said the sky was its roof and described it as the highest cathedral in the world.From potter to constructorBorn in 1931 in the Nièvre, Linard was trained in engraving at the École Estienne in Paris and then moved to central France, where he was attracted to the potters of La Borne, in the Cher. With his Danish wife, Anne, he bought an old flint quarry at Neuvy-Deux-Clochers and erected a residence there on the pattern of Danish farms, using beams, tiles and joinery which they recovered from other buildings. The Ministry’s description states the complex grew from 1961 till his death.Then the cathedral was to come. The French camper van tour guide says he launched it after a communal art project collapsed due to administrative problems, and it became the job of his life. He had no formal plan, and referred to himself as a self-taught constructor.Arches, mosaics and mirrorsSPACES, which documents art environments, says Linard began the cathedral after 1983. It consists of grand brick arches and triangles dressed in ceramic mosaic and set around his home, which he built himself from recycled materials in the hollow of the quarry. Local reporting puts the main structure at around ten metres high.The ornamentation is heavy. More than 80 names of deities, prophets and artists are engraved across the arches, according to the same camper van guide, and surrounding the site metal statues keep vigil. The Ministry defines the cathedral as ecumenical, paying honour to the major monotheistic religions and to the individuals Linard liked, from Buddha to Mandela, including Gaudí and Facteur Cheval.Sculptures in ceramic pieces, coloured discs and mirrors disperse light around it, and iron and cement sculptures coated in coloured mosaic portray the faithful. The facility also has a place for his pottery, a forest amphitheatre, and SPACES adds that it offers cultural events in the summer. Building it was one problem; keeping it alive after Linard’s death was another.Life after Linard The site passed through a troubled succession after his death and fell into disuse It was cared for by an association until 2019, and in 2022 a young couple, Charlotte and William, took it over, according to French travel reports. The cathedral’s official website states that it is open from Easter to All Saints’ Day and has a cafeteria and tea room on site. It has been selected for the Fondation du patrimoine’s Mission Bern initiative, which allows it to launch a tax-deductible fundraising drive for its upkeep.It has started to draw crowds, too. Local figures quoted by regional media said it had 7,161 visits in 2018, making it the fourth most-visited monument in the Cher at the time. Linard’s own account was basic. He sought a space for all faiths and built it with whatever was on hand.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Fahnbulleh says she backs home secretary on migration after comments to journalists
articles.summary: Energy secretary says she "didn't get it right" over comments she made about a TV interview.
articles.body:
The energy minister has insisted she backs Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood's immigration reforms after she made what she described as a "light-hearted remark".

Miatta Fahnbulleh was repeatedly asked in an interview on Wednesday whether she supported the government's plans to increase the time it takes for migrants to gain permanent UK residency, but refused to.

Referring to that exchange, she joked to reporters on Thursday that she did not explicitly answer the question because she had told herself she would "never lie".

In a later statement, she said: "Today I made what was meant to be a light-hearted self-deprecating remark. I didn't get it right and it hasn't come off as I intended."

She added: "I fully support our home secretary and the government's position on migration reform."

Permanent residence, or indefinite leave to remain, gives a person the right to live, work and study in the UK for as long as they like and apply for benefits if they are eligible.

The government wants to double the time it takes most migrant workers to qualify for permanent residence from five years to 10 years, while in the case of refugees it could take 20 years.

Mahmood told Labour Party conference in September the government would "come to a position that balances fairness for those who came here legally and fairness to British citizens across this country".

But a significant number of Labour MPs and trade unions want her to water down the proposed policy .

Downing Street has repeatedly insisted that Mahmood is considering responses to a consultation exercise before finalising the reforms.

On Wednesday, the prime minister's official spokesman said: "The home secretary is leading a thorough piece of work to make sure we get this right."

Asked earlier on the same day on Sky News, whether she backed the proposed reforms, Fahnbulleh said: "We have got to reform our immigration system, and my view is that we need a system that is based on the principle of compassion, contribution."

She was pressed several more times on the issue, saying the government was consulting on the proposals and would "will come out with the measures that we take forward".

At a lunch with political reporters on Thursday, Fahnbulleh said: "I made three promises to myself when I came into politics. The first was never lie, which has created some awkward moments including being interviewed by Sophy Ridge [on Sky] yesterday, but nevermind."

In her later statement, she said this was a joke and suggested it was not intended to show she did not support Mahmood's reforms.

"As I said earlier this week, it's absolutely right that people should have to make a contribution to this country in order to earn citizenship," Fahnbulleh said.

It comes after another Cabinet minister, Angela Rayner, criticised the proposed changes ahead of Labour's conference in Liverpool.

Rayner warned about shifting "the goalposts years down the line" for people who arrived in the UK at the beginning of this decade, expecting to secure permanent residence under the current rules.

She later denied there was a split within the heart of government over the issue.

articles.title: In 2017, YouTuber Elton Castee spent 151 hours livestreaming from a dog kennel; the campaign ultimately raised $188,275 for SPCA LA, including Hurricane Harvey relief
articles.summary: In an incredible fundraising effort, YouTuber Elton Castee spent 151 hours in a dog kennel, raising $188,275 for SPCA LA, helping animals in need while also supporting Hurricane Harvey relief efforts.
articles.body: Elton Castee, a YouTuber, in 2017 concluded a livestream that lasted for 151 hours from a dog kennel and raised $188,275 for the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Los Angeles (SPCA LA). Castee had entered kennel 420 at the SPCA LA PD Pitchford Companion Animal Village & Education Center in Long Beach, California, at noon on 27 August 2017. He planned to remain there until donations reached his original target and broadcast continuously from the facility while viewers kept up with the challenge online. According to SPCA LA’s press release, Castee ended his livestream after exceeding his revised goal of raising $150,000.A memorial initiative expanded to support Hurricane disaster reliefAfter losing his adopted dog named Sparta in 2016, Castee approached SPCA LA in May 2017 regarding the initiative, three months before streaming. The fact that he had adopted his dog from the same organisation made the fundraising as a tribute very fitting. He started the livestream with an initial target of reaching $100,000, which he achieved on the morning of 30 August after three continuous days of streaming. Afterwards, Castee upped the ante and increased the goal to $150,000, of which $50,000 was allocated towards SPCA LA’s Disaster Animal Response Team (DART).Around the same time, when Castee had entered the kennel, Hurricane Harvey had struck the Gulf Coast. SPCA LA responded accordingly, in coordination with Houston SPCA, and prepared to send responders to Texas; the two organisations had worked together as a team during Hurricanes Katrina, Rita, and Ike.In their announcement made on 30 August 2017, SPCA LA had planned to deploy DART as part of the third wave of responders, potentially beginning on 2 September. On 3 September, a follow-up announcement confirmed that DART members had set off to Texas on the morning of the day before to support and assist Houston SPCA. The deployed team consisted of humane officers, veterinary staff, and animal caregivers. The money raised by Castee was intended to support medical supplies, transport for animals, and all other expenses incurred during the Hurricane Harvey rescue effort.Donations sustained animal welfare servicesThe fundraising campaign found its supporters in the form of individual donors alongside sales from Castee’s clothing line called the SEND IT CC. SPCA LA also stated in September 2017 that by the time Castee’s live streaming concluded, it had garnered a viewership of more than seven million people who tuned in. On top of that, the live stream received 1,500 comments per second, and this broadcast, titled “Locked in a Kennel,” was consistently ranked among YouTube’s top three videos.For an independent organisation that operated without any financial backing from a national SPCA parent organisation or umbrella group, these donations were highly important. In response, SPCA LA President Madeline Bernstein said: “I can’t say enough about Elton’s determination and the generosity of his fans. From the bottom of our hearts – Thank you!”The SPCA LA was established in 1877 and operated in Southern California. It was set up with the objective of providing food, a safe shelter, and veterinary care for animals who had been abused and abandoned while investigating cases of animal cruelty across Los Angeles County. Besides animal welfare, the organisation has also established programmes to prevent violence, intervene when needed, and educational initiatives for middle and high school students in the communities of Compton, Hawthorne, Long Beach, and Hollywood.You use AI every day. articles.title: Federal authorities charge 15 in massive $1.8B Southern California medical fraud sweep
articles.summary: Federal raids across Southern California targeted 15 suspects, including a cardiothoracic surgeon, in nearly $2 billion in healthcare fraud schemes.
articles.body: Federal authorities conducted predawn raids across Southern California on Thursday, busting suspected fraudsters, including a cardiothoracic surgeon, accused of stealing nearly $2 billion through sham substance abuse programs, unnecessary surgeries and phony hospice care. In total, 15 people, including six medical professionals, were charged over $1. 8 billion in fraudulent claims submitted to government and private health insurance programs, the Justice Department said. "These charges include the largest sober home fraud scheme the Department has ever prosecuted and a scheme involving unnecessary invasive procedures that was detected through data analytics," said Assistant Attorney General Colin McDonald of the Justice Department’s National Fraud Enforcement Division. FBI ADDS 2 FUGITIVES TO 'MOST WANTED FRAUDSTERS' LIST AMID HISTORIC $6.5B HEALTHCARE TAKEDOWN: PATEL "Our message is simple: if you steal health care dollars from the American taxpayer or abuse your position to harm patients, we are coming for you — and the data will lead us to you." Among the defendants are Dr. Harold Tabaie, 78, of Anaheim, a cardiothoracic surgeon, and his business partner, Hany Malek, 61, a Tarzana chiropractor. Both are charged in an alleged $135 million scheme to bill Medicare for medically unnecessary atherectomies, invasive arterial procedures using a bladed catheter to clear plaque. Prosecutors allege Malek posed as a medical doctor to diagnose patients with arterial disease and recommend atherectomies, even though the patients did not have the condition. CALIFORNIA DOCTOR CONVICTED OF $45M MEDICARE FRAUD SCHEME THAT FUNDED LUXURY VACATIONS AND A $12K CROSSBOW Tabaie then performed the procedures, sometimes repeatedly on patients for whom previous operations had already failed, according to officials. Authorities noted that several patients suffered extreme pain and discomfort as a result. Malek also faces charges for allegedly submitting fraudulent Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) loan applications in 2021. He allegedly fabricated a 25% revenue loss for his business to secure loan funds, which he then spent on personal expenses, family credit cards, other ventures and rare coins. TOP FEDERAL PROSECUTOR CALLS CALIFORNIA A 'FRAUDSTER'S PARADISE,' WARNS STATE OFFICIALS COULD FACE CHARGES In a separate case, Nathan Young, 39, and his father, David Young, 71, were charged with operating a $1.6 billion substance abuse scam. Authorities allege the father-son duo trafficked drug addicts from across the nation to dozens of Los Angeles rehab centers. Federal prosecutors said the vulnerable patients were recruited by "body brokers" Honey Phipps, 42, and Cody Phipps, 36, both of Greenville, Texas. Body brokerage is the illegal practice of receiving kickbacks to refer insured individuals to specific rehab facilities. Once patients arrived, no actual treatment was provided. Instead, the Youngs allegedly recycled patients through their facilities to continuously bill insurance companies, even ordering staff to drug patients with sedatives to "knock them out" if they attempted to leave. VANCE ANTI-FRAUD TASK FORCE SUSPENDS 447 HOSPICES IN LOS ANGELES OVER MORE THAN $600M IN SUSPECTED FRAUD The duo also allegedly offered drugs to patients, cut them off from communication with family members, prevented them from accessing their belongings and physically blocked them from leaving the facilities to continue billing their insurance policies. When Nathen Young was informed that a patient wanted to leave detox so he could smoke marijuana, Young instructed that the patient should be given what he wanted, off-site from the detox, to keep him there, prosecutors said. "It is especially egregious when doctors and other health care professionals, who pledged to do no harm, resort to petty greed and criminality," said First Assistant United States Attorney Bill Essayli. "Every dollar drained out of our private and public health insurance systems is one less dollar available to those who truly need it." The sweep also targeted several other major healthcare fraud schemes across the region. In one instance, defendants were charged with stealing more than $140 million by falsely certifying non-terminally ill patients for hospice care. In a separate prescription fraud scheme, Christina Mareik, 61, of Whittier, was charged for her role in allegedly submitting thousands of bogus prescriptions for high-reimbursement generic drugs to Medi-Cal, California's Medicaid program. FOUR CHARGED IN ALLEGED BILLION DOLLAR HEALTHCARE FRAUD TIED TO RUSSIAN TRANSNATIONAL CRIMINAL ORGANIZATION CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Additionally, Dr. Hassan Badday, 48, of Los Angeles, and Dr. Robby Ayoub, 52, of Huntington Beach, were charged with taking illegal kickbacks from a Houston laboratory marketer in exchange for ordering unnecessary Medicare genetic tests.

articles.title: Israel frees suspects in two settler attacks as West Bank pogroms intensify
articles.summary: Israeli court releases nine settler suspects over West Bank attacks as investigations into recent assaults continue.
articles.body:
Israel has released nine of the 10 Israeli settler suspects arrested over attacks on a US journalist and European diplomats in the occupied West Bank, placing them under house arrest.

An Israeli court in Jerusalem ordered the release late on Wednesday, according to Honenu, a law firm that represents Israeli settlers.

Israeli police said one suspect remained in custody and that the investigation into the violent incidents was continuing.

Masked settlers were filmed last week assaulting Heidi Levine , a Washington Post photojournalist covering a Palestinian olive harvest who was taken to hospital and underwent surgery on a finger.

In a separate attack earlier this week, masked settlers assaulted French, Belgian and Polish diplomats and a French mayor in another part of the West Bank.

The suspects had been detained after the United States called for a crackdown on settler violence. France, Belgium and Poland also urged Israel to act.

“In the vast majority of attacks against Palestinians, no arrests are made at all,” said Yonatan Kanonich, head of research at the Israeli rights group Yesh Din. “In cases that receive media coverage … the police arrest several settlers and release most of them shortly afterward.”

United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres said in a post on X Thursday that the situation in the occupied Palestinian territory was “out of control”, with Palestinians continuing “to suffer daily attacks by Israeli settlers” and journalists and diplomats also being attacked.

Guterres called for “a credible political path towards lasting peace”.

Separately, the Palestinian Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission on Thursday said it documented 17 West Bank pogroms by Israeli forces and settlers against Palestinian farmers and their land during the olive harvest.

The commission recorded 409 attacks in October, 317 of which were by settlers and 92 by Israeli forces.

Nablus recorded the most attacks, 166, followed by Salfit with 91.

The commission said the attacks included assaults on farmers, preventing them from reaching their land, theft of crops and agricultural equipment, damage and burning of olive trees, as well as arrests, threats at gunpoint and live fire.

Ali Hassan Bazzari from Burqa died of wounds from settler gunfire while picking olives on October 7, the commission reported.

On Thursday, settlers set fire to olive trees near Imatin, east of Qalqilya, while Israeli forces forced farmers to leave and detained a farmer and several of his workers, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported.

Near Yabad, west of Jenin, settlers stole 17 bags of harvested olives and equipment, local sources said.

Citing a local Palestinian official, Wafa reported that around Jenin, Israeli forces closed transport roads and most village gates, preventing farmers from reaching land in Barta’a.

articles.title: In 1937, retired Oklahoma teacher Ed Galloway began a folk-art park; 11 years later, his hollow, nine-level totem pole stood 90 feet tall on a turtle
articles.summary: Explore Ed Galloway's Totem Pole Park, a stunning folk-art destination in Oklahoma featuring a 90-foot totem pole and unique Native American artistry. Learn about its history, restoration efforts, and the artistic vision behind this historic Route 66 attraction.
articles.body: In 1937, Nathan Edward Galloway retired and settled on a property in Oklahoma and began creating a collection of folk-art structures which would eventually be known as Ed Galloway’s Totem Pole Park. Located near Foyil in Rogers County, the park, managed by the Rogers County Historical Society, features a 90-foot-tall totem pole made out of sandstone, wood, steel, and concrete. According to the National Park Service, the construction took place from 1937 and continued to 1961,with the totem pole being realised between 1937 and 1948. The site serves as a historic attraction along Route 66 and has been listed on the National Register of Historic Places. The structure was made tangible through Galloway’s woodworking skills, led by his personal interest in decorative art.Galloway spent 11 years constructing the 90-foot totem poleNational Park Service records show that Galloway was born in Springfield, Missouri, in 1880, and as a young boy became a wood carver, an interest that eventually developed into a talent for woodworking and blacksmithing. His early experience found him working at Sand Springs Home in Oklahoma, where he taught orphan boys manual arts. After his retirement, he moved to the property that became the park; he built a smokehouse, a workshop, and made violins, furniture, and decorative wall art.The inspiration for the totem pole stemmed from Galloway’s own personal interest in Native American art, and he used postcards and National Geographic magazines to draw out his ideas. His totem pole, which took over 11 years of work, became the largest artistic structure on the property.The pole is made from steel, wood and concrete, while its exterior is thick with red sandstone, and its carved bas-reliefs are decorated with birds and Native American figures. Each of the designs is arranged in a way that faces the four cardinal directions, and as per the account of FolkArtwork, there are 200 carved images across the main structure; these are mainly portraits, symbols, and animal figures.The structure rises from the back of a large, three-dimensional turtle carved from a sandstone outcrop on the property. Inside, the hollow tower ascends through nine levels, with the ground floor measuring nine feet in diameter. Painted murals depicting mountain-and-lake scenes and bird totems decorate the plastered interior. Native American shields and arrow points appear above the murals, while the cone at the top remains open to the sky.Excluding the structures, other designs of Galloway extend through the grounds, and the National Park Service has identified them as an Arrowhead Totem, a Birdbath Totem, and a Tree Totem. In addition, the park also has concrete picnic table totem designs, a barbecue fireplace, and fish-shaped gate structures.The Fiddle House preserves Galloway's other creationsBeyond the outdoor monuments, the property houses an eleven-sided building known as the Fiddle House, which resembles a Navajo hogan embellished with totemic columns and Native American portraits. FolkArtwork adds that Galloway used wood that his former students from different parts of the world had sent to create the wooden fiddles.Galloway pursued the development of the park until he passed in 1961, after which the site fell into a state of disrepair. The Rogers County Historical Society acquired the property in 1989 and, in a joint effort with the Kansas Grassroots Arts Association, undertook the restoration work. According to the National Park Service, the restoration work included repainting, replacing deteriorated materials, and replicating elements that could no longer be preserved.You use AI every day. articles.summary: The best gifts to buy coffee lovers include beans, mugs, brewers and brewing accessories. Here are our top picks, hand-picked by coffee lovers themselves.
articles.body: I wake up, go to sleep and spend many hours in between thinking about my next cup of coffee, so it’s not an exaggeration to call myself the expert when it comes to finding the best gifts for coffee lovers (at least at NBC Selected). Coffee-flavored lip balms, delectable syrups, adorable espresso cups, sleek brewers that double as decor, chocolate-covered beans — I could go on and on. I’ll continue to update this article throughout the holiday season in case you need even more inspiration. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. The dishwasher-safe mug keeps drinks hot for up to three hours in cordless mode with the lid, or all day when resting on the included charging coaster. The Ember Mug 3 comes in 10-ounce, 14-ounce and 16-ounce sizes. The tiny 2-inch plushie is great decor at the office or at home, and it might even kickstart your giftee’s Jellycat collection. We all have that one person in our lives who only drinks iced lattes. If that sounds like someone you’re buying a gift for, look no further than this espresso cooling ball. It sits on a cup underneath a machine’s spout, and as the espresso brews, it passes over the ball before dripping into the cup. The ball, which your giftee has to freeze for at least four hours beforehand, instantly lowers the espresso’s temperature by 80 to 100 degrees and removes bitter notes, according to the brand. That means the shot is the perfect temperature to immediately add to a cup with ice and milk — no more waiting around for it to cool down. “The cooling ball definitely makes espresso shots taste better than a normal brew and speeds up the whole process,” says NBC Selected associate social media editor Caitlin Cusack, who uses it at home every day. We recommend using the cooling balls (this comes as a set of two) as a secret Santa or white elephant gift, making them a stocking stuffer or gifting them alongside beans or espresso cups (like the Yeti ones below). Everything comes packed inside a box, so you can ship it directly to your recipient or put a bow on it and give it to them in person. No coffee machine? No problem. By following the ratios on the bottles, your loved one can use Jot’s coffee concentrates to make hot coffee, iced coffee and espresso-based drinks like lattes. This trio comes with three types of Jot coffee concentrate: original, vanilla and dark (an extra bold variety). I’ve tried them all and am impressed by how smooth and flavorful they are regardless of what drink I use them for. Each bottle makes 14 servings. Your giftee can also use Cometeer’s frozen coffee concentrate pods to make hot, iced and espresso-based beverages without a brewer (there’s directions on the box that walk them through exactly how). The brand works with popular roasters across the country to bring their blends to customers, and this bundle lets your loved one try a handful of them. It’s curated by Cometeer’s team the week you buy it to ensure your giftee gets the freshest pods possible. They’ll receive five sleeves of coffee with eight capsules in each one, letting them make 40 cups total. You can choose from six types of bundles: mixed roast, medium roast, light roast, dark roast, decaf and half-caff. You’ll instantly upgrade your giftee’s coffee game by getting them Proper’s syrups, which come in flavors like vanilla, salted caramel, simple, pumpkin spice and pistachio. They come in glass bottles that are good looking enough to be displayed on your giftee’s coffee bar, and Cusack says they’re some of the best ones she’s tasted. “One of my pet peeves is when the syrup sinks to the bottom of my drink, but I haven’t found that with Proper syrups — they blend in quickly, so I’m not finishing my coffee with a gulp of straight syrup,” she says. “The flavors are subtle, not too overpowering or too sweet and make a great addition to my morning iced lattes. The machine also has an automatic steam wand, and your loved one can adjust the milk temperature and texture settings to their liking. They get all the accessories they need with the Breville Bambino, including filter baskets, a portafilter, a milk jug, a tamper and a steam wand cleaning tool, as well as two bags of coffee. “My husband is a huge pour-over coffee fan, so I got him the Chemex as a gift and it’s become a staple in my house,” says Godio. The top of the Chemex is cone-shaped, so your loved one adds a disposable filter and their favorite grounds, pours hot water over them, and watches as coffee drips into the bottom. “The carafe is insulated to keep the coffee hot, and the wood collar and leather tie serve as a handle, so I don’t burn my hand when I pour it into a mug,” says Godio. Your giftee can take the “handle” off and the carafe is dishwasher-safe for easy cleanup. The Chemex comes in 3-cup, 6-cup, 8-cup and 10-cup sizes. The traveler or outdoor enthusiast in your life won’t have to settle for mediocre coffee on the go once you buy them Wacaco’s portable machine, which NBC Selected video editor Josh Rios calls a “pocket barista that makes a solid cut of espresso.” Your giftee can simply add ground beans and hot water to the lightweight, compact gadget, and press down on a button to brew manually — it’s battery-free and doesn’t need to be charged. Its cap doubles as a cup, too. “Yes, the Moccamaster is expensive for a drip coffee maker, but it’s one of my favorite things I own,” says Godio. The caffeine-obsessed person in your life will feel the same once they set it up, and since it has such a sleek look, it will become a focal point in their kitchen. “The flavor of the coffee is so much better than any other drip coffee maker I’ve tried, and I can keep the glass carafe on the hot plate so my coffee stays warm for over an hour.” The Moccamaster can make up to 10 cups of coffee in four to six minutes, and your giftee can control the holding temperature of the hot plate post-brewing. Mugs and brewing accessories New York City’s iconic Greek Coffee Cup is one of my favorite keepsakes to give friends and family who live in the area, moved away or love visiting. It’s made from ceramic, so it’s dishwasher- and microwave-safe, and it holds about 10 ounces of coffee. Your loved one can drink from it, but it’s also a cute tchotchke to display at home or put pens in on a desk. As someone who often drinks coffee while commuting and walking my dog in the morning, I always love unwrapping a high-quality travel mug like this one from Owala.
